acquisition_method: experiment types: Bottom-up proteomics; Affinity purification coupled with mass spectrometry proteomics; Data-dependent acquisition
alkylation_concentration: lysates were centrifuged for 30 min at 3,000g in a swing-out centrifuge with delayed deceleration, carefully decanted into new tubes, and subsequently passed through 0.45 μm disc filters in order to clarify them.
alkylation_reagent: in addition to 10 μL of 0.5 M freshly dissolved chloroacetamide (CAA).
cleavage_agent: peptides were purified on C8 SepPak and lyophilized, after which they were dissolved in IAP buffer and immunoprecipitated using (per sample) ~7 μL of 8A2 anti-SUMO2/3 antibody coupled to (per sample) 25 μL Protein G Agarose beads.
collision_energy: fragmented using higher-energy collision disassociation (HCD) with normalized collision energy of 25.
enrichment_method: immunoprecipitated using (per sample) ~7 μL of 8A2 anti-SUMO2/3 antibody coupled to (per sample) 25 μL Protein G Agarose beads.
fractionation_method: High-pH fractionation of SUMOylated peptides was performed on StageTip
fragmentation_method: fragmented using higher-energy collision disassociation (HCD) with normalized collision energy of 25.
instrument: All samples were analyzed using an EASY-nLC 1200 system (Thermo) coupled to an Orbitrap Exploris™ 480 mass spectrometer (Thermo).
ionization_type: ionization was achieved using a NanoSpray Flex™ NG (Thermo) with the spray voltage set at 2 kV
mass_analyzer: All samples were analyzed using an EASY-nLC 1200 system (Thermo) coupled to an Orbitrap Exploris™ 480 mass spectrometer (Thermo).
ptm: Variable modifications used were protein N-terminal acetylation, methionine oxidation, peptide N-terminal pyroglutamate, and Lys SUMOylation, with a maximum of 3 modifications per peptide.
reduction_concentration: lysates were centrifuged for 30 min at 3,000g in a swing-out centrifuge with delayed deceleration, carefully decanted into new tubes, and subsequently passed through 0.45 μm disc filters in order to clarify them.
reduction_reagent: supplemented with 5 mM CAA and 5 mM TCEP, and incubated at 37 °C for 30 minutes.
